title: Chengdu 18th Middle School SMP
description: The Minecraft server of the Chengdu Eighteenth Middle School Minecraft club. Publically avaliable. 成都18中学的MC社团服务器，欢迎加入
body:
!!Server is no longer open!!
Due to funding problems the server is no longer online now. Do not join the server.

The Minecraft SMP server of the Chengdu Eighteenth Middle school Minecraft club. Now publically avaliable. English support is not complete right now. If you need English help with the server's mechanics, please join our English support Discord server: https://discord.gg/MdfKJge3kY

A Microsoft premium account is **not** required, and the server uses AuthMe. However, it is recommended to use a premium account to show your skin and makes things easier for administration.

**Server Info:**
- Keep Inventory off
- Allows piston end portal duplication
- No redstone restrictions
- Simple Voice Chat is avaliable on the server

！！服务器倒闭了！！
因为资金不足 服务器已倒闭 不要再进来了

成都18中学社团的MC生存服务器，欢迎来玩喵～

**无须正版**，使用AuthMe插件防盗号

**服务器信息：**
- 死亡掉落
- 允许使用刷沙机
- 目前不限制生电
- 服务器安装了简单的语音通话（Simple Voice Chat）模组，可以语音

服务器目前还没有交流QQ群，不过可以加我QQ：3495893052
